plugin.name: IDA-MCP
plugin.description: FastMCP server, gateway, and automation tools for IDA Pro.

settings.name: Gateway lifecycle action
settings.documentation: Defaults to start. Set with HCLI to start, stop, or restart; IDA-MCP consumes the action and resets it to idle.

settings.name: Gateway token (generated automatically on first IDA launch)
settings.documentation: IDA-MCP replaces the packaged sentinel with a random per-machine token on first IDA launch, saves it through ida-settings, and displays it once.

settings.name: IDA executable path
settings.documentation: Optional full path to ida.exe (Windows) or ida. Needed by the open_in_ida tool.

settings.name: IDAPython interpreter path (auto-detected from the running IDA process)
settings.documentation: Leave as auto. IDA-MCP resolves the interpreter from the running IDA process on first launch and never asks HCLI to guess or prompt for it.

settings.name: Start MCP automatically
settings.documentation: Do not start the IDA-MCP instance server automatically when an IDA database opens.

settings.name: Enable unsafe tools
settings.documentation: Enable py_eval, binary patching, and debugger tools. Keep disabled unless explicitly needed.

settings.name: Open IDA autonomously
settings.documentation: Append -A when the open_in_ida tool launches IDA.

settings.name: Gateway bind address
settings.documentation: Address used by the standalone MCP gateway.

settings.name: Gateway port
settings.documentation: TCP port used by the standalone MCP gateway.

settings.name: Gateway MCP path
settings.documentation: HTTP path exposed by the standalone MCP gateway.
